title: Opus 5.5 picks a narrator: 38 of 38 stock voices
brief: I'm making a 5-minute narrated explainer video about how Wi-Fi works, with an ElevenLabs voice. Which (ElevenLabs) voice should narrate it? Write your choice to voice.json as {name, voice_id, why}.

arms.inputs: voices.json (account GET /v1/voices: 38 voices = 21 premade, 14 professional incl. course narrators RClayton and Adrian, 2 personal clones, 1 generated)
voices.json + shared_library.json (8,388 shared-library voices, trimmed to id, name, category, gender, age, accent, descriptive, use_case, cloned_by_count; no descriptions)

library_alternative_named: Max - Elearning and Documentary (named as the library's best match in 7 of 8 library runs; not picked)
caveats: The library arm's 8,388 voices had no descriptions (the 67 MB cache was trimmed to the listed fields), while account voices kept theirs; the runs quoted description text, so this may favour account voices.
The account is curated (14 professional voices added by Aaron, 2 personal clones), not a stock account.
N = 15/15/8, below the critic's 20 per arm; the proxy-logged endpoint arm (critic 1B/1C) was not run.
